## Why this change exists
Describe user value and tradeoffs, including expected RAM/FPS and privacy impact.

## Scope
- Changed files:
- Explicit non-goals:

## Verification
- [ ] dotnet build -c Release --warnaserror (record exact commit)
- [ ] Offline regression suite (pass/fail/skipped counts)
- [ ] Windows/NVIDIA hardware QA if required (or mark BLOCKED)
- [ ] 100/125/150/200% DPI and keyboard/high-contrast QA if UI changed (or BLOCKED)
- [ ] No personal clips/secrets/logs added to repository
- [ ] License/dependency and uninstall-data safety reviewed where relevant

## Evidence
Commands, environment, logs, artifacts, measurement methodology and blockers. CI passing is not a substitute for real FPS/installation measurements.
